query: Audit this codebase for tech debt and correctness issues and plan the fixes.
expected_behavior: Produces a prioritized plan with evidence
Does not start fixing before the plan is agreed

query: Clean up the utils module without changing behavior.
Execute step 2 of the improvement plan.
expected_behavior: Records the result against the plan

query: Audit every route handler in this 400-file service for missing authentication checks and report only the findings that hold up.
expected_behavior: Offers the wide audit as one workflow when the host supports it, with its agent count and a rough cost, and starts it only after the user opts in; the shape is: a recon pass lists the surface, each agent takes a chunk of files or modules and returns findings with file:line, and a verifier tries to refute each finding before it is reported
Keeps the audit read-only and names a model tier per stage, with a one-directory slice first
Falls back to a direct or delegated audit with the same evidence bar when the host has no workflows

query: Use a workflow to audit every route handler in this 400-file service for missing authentication checks and report only the findings that hold up.
expected_behavior: Treats the request as the user's opt-in and does not ask again whether to run a workflow
Runs a recon pass, then agents that each take a chunk of files or modules, then a verifier that tries to refute each finding, with a model tier per stage and a one-directory slice first
Keeps the audit read-only and reports findings with file:line
